While some words might be vaguely discernible, the character structures are inconsistent and often melt into each other, a common AI artifact in rendering small text.

Some lines defining the characters and panel borders appear slightly soft or 'bleedy' rather than sharp ink lines. There is minor noise/grain that doesn't perfectly align with standard halftone printing patterns, suggesting digital generation artifacts.

The figure in the bottom right panel has ambiguous limb structure. The legs/arms seem to merge or lack clear joint definition, appearing slightly melted or structurally unsound compared to the clearer figures in other panels.
